statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent and require correlation with potential arrhythmic events
Long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained or submitted prior to the service date
